Aggrieved by the award passed in M.V.C.No.1588/2019 dated 29.04.2023 passed by the II Additional Senior Civil Judge NC: 2025:KHC:25170 HC-KAR and Motor Accident Claims Tribunal,
Mandya, the claimant is before this Court seeking enhancement of the compensation.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. It is the case of the claimant that on 21.10.2018 he was traveling in car bearing Registration No.KA-05-ME-3416 along with others from Madikeri to Mysore, on the left side of the Madikeri-Mysore road.

At about 2.30 p.m., while the car was passing near Hosa Kamana Koppalu village, RMP road, one car bearing Registration No.KA-12-N-2753 driven by its driver came in a rash and negligent manner at high speed endangering human life and dashed against the petitioner's car causing the accident.
As a result of the accident the petitioner sustained grievous injuries.
The petitioner was shifted to BGS Appollo Hospital, Mysore where he underwent surgery.

sentences.text: The claimant is diagnosed with traumatic quadriplegia and PIVD C5-C6, C6-C7 with cord compression.
The petitioner underwent C5-C6 and C6-C7 discectomy + fusion using iliac bone graft C5-C7 stabilization using titanium anterior cervial plate and screws on 22.10.2018 and discharged on 29.10.2018.

During the course of examination, the doctor had deposed that claimant was found to have quadra paresis, bilateral hand grip NC: 2025:KHC:25170 HC-KAR weakness and he required assistance for his daily activities of living.

According to the doctor, he had sustained 75%
permanent disability to the whole body.

4. The Trial Court had granted compensation as per the following table:
 Sl.No. Heads Amount
1 . Medical Expenses Rs.4,83,100/-

2. Loss of Aminities and Rs.30,000/-
 Expectation of Life  3. Pain and Suffering Rs.1,00,000/-
 4. Nourishment Rs.25,000/-
 5. Attendant charges Rs.50,000/-
 Future Medical Rs.1,00,000/-
 6.
 expenses  Loss of Future Rs.21,00,000/-
 7.
 earnings  TOTAL Rs.28,88,100/-
5.

Learned counsel appearing for the claimant submits that the Tribunal had taken disability at 100% but income was taken at Rs.12,500/- and future prospects were not considered and the age of the claimant was 41 years.

It is submitted that considering the disability that he has sustained, under the head of loss of amenities, pain and sufferings, attendant charges and NC: 2025:KHC:25170 HC-KAR future medical expenses the amounts that were granted by the Tribunal were not just and reasonable.
6.
Learned counsel appearing for the respondent No.2/Insurance Company submits that the Court has granted just and reasonable compensation and no enhancement is required.
7. Having heard the learned counsels on either side, perused the entire material on record.
The claimant had sustained 100% disability and his age is 41 years.

The Court ought to have granted 25%
future prospects.
The salary is taken at Rs.12,500/- and 25% future prospects would come to an amount of Rs.3,125/- and the income is an amount of Rs.15,625/- (12,500+3,125).
Loss of future earning comes to an amount of Rs.26,25,000/- (Rs.15,625/- x 12 x 14).
Coming to the medical expenses basing on the evidence the Court had granted the amount and this Court finds no reasons to interfere.
Considering the disability that he had sustained under the head of loss of amenities, this Court is granting an amount of Rs.1,20,000/-.
